title: Leases
description: Every lease of your buildings, newest first.
newBody: The standard residential lease, checked against the consumer-protection rules as you go.

empty.title: No leases here
empty.body: Start a lease from a vacant unit or with “New lease”.

wizard.draftBody: Unit {unit} for {party} was being prepared in this browser.
wizard.noVacant: No vacant units in this building.
wizard.searchPartyHint: At least 2 letters of a name, phone or email
wizard.defaultMonths: Leave empty for the unit type's default: {months} months
wizard.defaultApi: Leave empty for the default of this unit
wizard.capBody: Deposit and advance rent together may not exceed {months} months of rent. Larger amounts are refused when the draft is created.
wizard.meteredHint: Billed each month from the unit's meters at your rate plan.
wizard.includedHint: No utility charges on the bills of this lease.
wizard.linesHint: Fixed charges billed with the rent. The unit type's defaults are filled in.
wizard.addendumHint: Only these clause types may be added to the standard contract ({legalRef}).
wizard.fixHint: Go back to the step with the problem, change it and try again.
wizard.contractBody: The contract is the platform's standard residential lease ({template}) with your addendum.
wizard.sentBody: The resident signs in the resident app; then you countersign.

invite.title: Invite to the resident app
invite.body: A one-time code links the resident's LINE to this lease. It is shown once only.
invite.smsSent: The invitation was sent by SMS.
invite.once: This code cannot be shown again. Create a new invitation if it is lost.

actions.sendBody: The lease of unit {unit} can no longer be changed once sent. The resident signs in the resident app.
actions.countersignBody: Your signature as lessor completes the lease of unit {unit}.
actions.noticeTitle: Record a notice to end the lease
actions.noticeBody: A written notice for unit {unit}, from the resident or from you.
actions.effectiveDateHint: The notice period is checked by the platform
actions.renewBody: A new lease for unit {unit} starts when this one ends.
actions.beginMoveOutBody: Schedules the move-out inspection of unit {unit}.
actions.completeMoveOutBody: Unit {unit} becomes vacant and the deposit settlement starts its refund deadline.
actions.terminateBody: Terminates the lease of unit {unit} on the date below: a later date records the termination for that date, today or earlier closes it now. This cannot be undone.
actions.cancelBody: The lease of unit {unit} has not been signed; cancelling it frees the unit.
actions.terminateDateHint: A date after today records the termination for that date: the lease and access stay as they are until the office completes the move-out.
actions.terminationScheduled: Termination recorded, effective {date}. The resident keeps access until the office completes the move-out.

detail.title: Lease · unit {unit}
detail.noticeAccess: Nothing changes before {effective}: the resident keeps the unit and their door codes. The move-out starts on that date, and access ends only when the office completes it.
detail.endingBody: Complete the move-out once the resident has handed the unit back: that closes the lease and the occupancy, the unit becomes vacant, the resident's door codes end and the 7-day deposit clock starts. Until then the resident keeps access.
detail.endingBodyNoAction: The office completes the move-out; until then the resident keeps access.
detail.contractPiiOnly: The stored contract carries the lessee's ID / passport number. Only an Owner or Manager (personal data access) can open it.
detail.previewMasked: Your preview masks the lessee's ID / passport number.

preview.title: Legal checks before the draft
preview.checking: Checking the terms with the API…
preview.unavailable: The checks cannot run ahead right now; the API checks again when the draft is created.
preview.noChecks: No rule applies to this lease.
preview.outOfScope: This lease is outside the residential lease notice.
preview.problemHint: Change the terms in the previous steps and check again.
